sql: with aa (artifactid, authorid, affiliation, rank, authoridvalue, affiliationvalue ) as       ( select artifactid, authorid, affiliation, rank,                   jsonparse_q14(authorid, 'value') as authoridvalue,                  jsonparse_q14(affiliation, 'value') as affiliationvalue        from artifact_authors        where affiliation is not null and affiliation != '[]' and affiliation != ''  and                   authorid is not null and authorid != '[]' ) select aa.authoridvalue, aa.affiliationvalue from aa, artifacts a, projects_artifacts pr, projects p where aa.rank = 1       and aa.artifactid = a.id       and p.id = pr.projectid       and pr.artifactid = a.id       and p.funder = 'European Commission'       and (aa.authorid, cleandate(a.date)) in           (select authorid, aggregate_max(cleandate(a.date)) as max_date            from artifact_authors as aa, artifacts as a            where aa.rank = 1 and aa.artifactid = a.id            group by authorid)
